name: WCAG 2.2 Level AA
summary: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines 2.2, Level AA — the baseline for accessible UI; referenced by the ADA, EN 301 549, and Section 508.

requirements.summary: Non-text content has a text alternative (alt text, labels, captions).
Information and relationships conveyed visually are also exposed in markup/semantics.
Text has a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 (3:1 for large text).
UI components and graphics have at least 3:1 contrast against adjacent colors.
All functionality is operable from a keyboard, with no keyboard traps (2.1.2).
The keyboard focus indicator is visible.
Target size is at least 24×24 CSS px (WCAG 2.2 addition).
Don't ask users to re-enter info already provided in the same process (Redundant Entry, 2.2).
Name, role, and value of every UI component are programmatically available (ARIA).
